description: Mid-range RSI scenario: 20 candles alternating between +1.0 gains and -0.5 losses (period=14). Neither overbought nor oversold — RSI oscillates in the 60-70 band. Verifies Wilder smoothing preserves mid-range stability without drifting to extremes. First RSI = avgGain/avgLoss from 14 moves of alternating +1/-0.5 pattern.

expectedOutput.note: Mid-range RSI from alternating +1/-0.5 candles. avgGain=1.0*(8/14), avgLoss=0.5*(6/14) for first 14 moves. All values must be in (60, 75) range — neither overbought nor oversold.
